onboarding.title: Welcome to Warrantly
onboarding.subtitle: Keep every warranty in one place and see how many days are left.
onboarding.lockBody: Your warranties stay on this phone. A PIN keeps them private when someone else uses your phone. You can change this any time in Settings.

home.emptyBody: Connect Gmail, and Warrantly will find your receipts and warranties for you.
home.error: Couldn't read Gmail. Check your connection and try again.
home.failed: {{count}} emails couldn't be read. They will be retried at the next sync. First error: {{detail}}

warranty.needsInput: Some details are missing. You can fill them in soon.

form.startHint: Leave empty to use the purchase date. The warranty starts when you receive the product.
form.errDate: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
form.errStart: Enter a date on or after the purchase date, or leave it empty.
form.errMonths: Enter a length between 1 and 120 months.
form.pickerFailed: The calendar could not open, type the date instead. ({{detail}})

detail.deleteBody: This removes the warranty from this phone. It can't be undone.
detail.testReminder: Send a test reminder in 5 seconds
detail.noPermission: Notifications are turned off for Warrantly. Turn them on in Android settings.

reminder.today: The warranty ends today. Claim now if anything is wrong.

lock.title: Enter your PIN
lock.wait_one: Too many tries. Try again in {{count}} second.
lock.wait_other: Too many tries. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
lock.forgotPrompt: Confirm it's you to set a new PIN
lock.noDeviceLock: This phone has no screen lock, so the PIN can't be reset. Clear Warrantly's data in Android settings, then restore from a backup.

pin.hint: 4 to 6 digits. If you forget it, your phone's screen lock lets you set a new one.
pin.mismatch: The PINs don't match. Choose a PIN again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockHint: Ask for a PIN when the app opens, and after 3 minutes away.
settings.remindersHint: 90, 60 and 30 days before, then weekly, and on the last day.

backup.enableHint: Encrypted on this phone first. Drive only stores a file it can't read.

backupPassword.title: Backup password
backupPassword.body: You need this password to restore on a new phone. There is no server, so a lost password can't be recovered and the backup can't be opened.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.looking: Looking for backups on Google Drive…
restore.none: No backup found in the Warrantly Backups folder.
restore.passwordHint: Needed when the backup was made on another phone.
restore.confirmBody: Warranties on this phone are replaced with the backup from {{date}}. This can't be undone.
restore.done: Restored. Connect Gmail again to keep syncing.
